## Summary
Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Change type
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Database migration/configuration

## Validation
- [ ] Backend tests run or not applicable
- [ ] Frontend type check/build run or not applicable
- [ ] Relevant end-to-end flow checked or not applicable
- [ ] Documentation/environment examples updated

## Risk and rollout
Describe API, schema, environment, authorization, or deployment impact.

## Privacy and security
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, production logs, or personal data are included.
- [ ] New or changed protected operations enforce authorization on the backend.
